correctness.rationale: Finite-field map (a,b),(x,y) in (F_q^*)^2, entry 1[y=ax+b]. Reparametrization to rx+sy=1 diagonalizes under multiplicative characters with Jacobi multipliers, yielding singular values q-2, 1, sqrt q and rational invertibility for q>2. Mod-p character basis valid since p does not divide q-1; Lucas digit condition yields rank (p(p+1)/2)^f-2 for odd p and -3 for p=2. For prime p>=5 determinant p^e(p-2), rank mod p loses e and any ell|p-2 loses exactly one rank, forcing SNF 1^((p-1)^2-e), p^(e-1),p(p-2). Independently reconstructed B_p at p=3,5,7 and checked exact modular rank, determinant and square singular-value multiplicities. Edge case p=3 unimodular; no extension-field SNF claimed.
